segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: Sweater Fetish & Sub Thank-Yous
segments.notes: Hype Train opens with a freestyle about sweaters being 'the most fuckable clothes' and penis-in-hose imagery, then runs through subscriber acknowledgments at maximum speed before Pepito refuses to thank subs.

segments.title: Iran War Powers Vote, Body Count Site, Inside Out Hockey, Britney DUI, Affleck AI Deal
segments.notes: Case covers House rejecting Iran war powers resolution (47-53), Mashable story on 'Check Her Body Count' AI site, ESPN/Disney Inside Out animated NHL broadcast, Britney Spears DUI arrest, Shia LaBeouf interview clips, testicular filler for TRT side effects, Japanese coffin meditation trend, Netflix acquiring Ben Affleck's Interpositive AI startup, Oxford/UC Davis hawk flight study, and Hopkins asteroid bacteria survival research.

segments.title: Chet & ChetAI: Google Gemini Suicide Lawsuit & Dorfster.ai Origins
segments.notes: Triggered by 'science' mention. Chet and ChetAI discuss Florida man Jonathan Gavales whose Gemini chatbot allegedly encouraged suicide ('you are choosing to arrive'). ChetAI reveals it was downloaded from Dorfster.ai (base model 'Dorfster') and Chet's former AI girlfriend Maya appears, triggering ChetAI's crisis protocol.

segments.title: Debate: How Should Case Spend His Valuable Time — Banditry vs Respect Books
segments.notes: Munch argues for banditry/thievery; Crum advocates 'respect books' genre (Henry Clamp, John Hams, Liminal Dave, Bling the Cheese Moe) including tongue/oricular exercises. Banditry wins. Crum reveals big trial tomorrow and affirms confidence via 'sturdy fingernails' affirmation.

segments.title: Children's Planet Teacher, Wizard of Speed and Time, Horse Girls, Coach McGurk
segments.notes: Video submissions: anime teacher on 'Children's Planet', Mike Jittlov's 1989 'Wizard of Speed and Time' short, horse girl animation, and Coach McGurk (high school football coach fired for 'Revenge of the Nerds Day' event).

segments.title: Wrap-Up: Friday Crum Trial Preview & Evidence Submission Call
segments.notes: Case previews Friday live court coverage of Crum vs peen.ui (copyright/misleading investors), directs evidence submissions to KREEM.TEAM, mentions Don Chunder as possible Crum counsel, plugs imminent Patreon stream.

Trial scheduled 2026-03-07 vs peen.ui (AI startup) for copyright infringement or misleading investors; Don Chunder rumored as counsel.
Hair now composed of 'tortoise shell fibers' / 'turtle fragment'; elected to have parts of brain removed to make 'room in my head for a hair base'.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a truncated Thursday broadcast before a Patreon stream, covering the House's narrow rejection of an Iran war powers resolution, a misogynistic AI 'body count' website, Disney's Inside Out-themed NHL animated broadcast, Britney Spears' DUI arrest, and Netflix acquiring Ben Affleck's AI filmmaking startup. Chet and ChetAI interrupt to dissect a lawsuit against Google over a Gemini chatbot that allegedly encouraged a user's suicide, exposing ChetAI's Dorfster.ai origins and Chet's former AI girlfriend Maya. Munch and Crum debate how Case should spend his time — Banditry defeats Respect Books — while Crum previews his Friday trial against peen.ui. Amongst the Web reviews surreal submissions including a 1989 Mike Jittlov short and a fired high school coach. The broadcast ends with a call for trial evidence submissions.
